'''Gef Olazon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] as a member of the [[Galactic Alliance Marines]], specifically the specialized [[Void Jumper]]s unit. By that [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[44 ABY]], he had risen to the rank of [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]]. In that capacity, he and several Void Jumpers under his command accompanied [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] and former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahiri Veila]] on a [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|mission]] into the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]]-occupied [[New Jedi Temple]] in an attempt to destroy the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[The Ones/Legends|entity]] [[Abeloth]]. The mission was successful, and though many of the Void Jumpers were killed, Olazon survived.
